title: All 15 scenarios passed — epoch-safe map persistence changes verified
summary: All 15 Webots integration scenarios passed (15/15, 100%). The PR introduces epoch-safe semantic map persistence keyed by save tokens, replacing the legacy warm-restore approach. Changes span README, annotations, map_binding, map_meta, persistence, builder, service, object_registry, web, and tests. The CI exercised builtin, cap, and flow scenarios including camera/lidar snapshots, exploration, navigation, memory, speech, voiceprint, and scene object listing — all green.
pr_changes: system/scene/README.md: Documented epoch rule, Save/Load/Delete map library, SCENE_RESTORE_ON_START legacy mode, and lifecycle watcher epoch response.
system/scene/scene_service/annotations.py: Added has_saved() method to guard against overwriting never-loaded room annotations.
system/scene/scene_service/map_binding.py: Updated docstring to note lifecycle watcher acts on generation bump (flush + re-anchor).
system/scene/scene_service/map_meta.py: New file — MapMetaStore and MapSemanticMeta for epoch sidecar files pairing saved maps with object snapshot partitions.
system/scene/scene_service/persistence.py: Added partition-scoped persist/load_all, purge_live_partitions, strict mode for Load, and explicit partition parameter.
system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/builder.py: Object store only wired in legacy SCENE_RESTORE_ON_START mode; default Save/Load snapshot path passes None.

system/scene/scene_service/service.py: Major rewrite of lifecycle_watch to react to epoch bumps (flush objects, flag annotations stale). Added live_binding dict, map_ops_lock, MapMetaStore init, live-session cleanup, and purge_live_partitions call.
system/scene/scene_service/state/object_registry.py: Added clear_objects() method for lifecycle flush.

system/scene/scene_service/web.py: Added ops_lock, _persist_scene_objects with partition, _restore_scene_objects with strict mode, _latched_lifecycle helper, reserved map ID validation, and epoch-safe Save/Load/Delete logic with sidecar commit ordering.
system/scene/tests/test_lifecycle_flush.py: New file — state-machine tests for lifecycle watcher epoch response (confirm, bump, cross-map drift, facade load not drift, survival with None stores).
system/scene/tests/test_map_epoch.py: New file — epoch-safety tests for web map facade Save/Load/Delete with fake object store and ASGI calls.
system/scene/tests/test_map_meta.py: New file — unit tests for MapMetaStore roundtrip, corrupt sidecar, delete, sanitization, and forward compatibility.
system/scene/tests/test_persistence.py: Added test_partition_scoped_operations for explicit partition persist/load_all and purge_live_partitions.
test_result: Webots CI ran 15 scenarios across builtin (4), cap (8), and flow (3) families. All passed. Exercised capabilities: camera/lidar snapshots, map save, memory save/search, navigation, speech, voiceprint list, explore start/status/cancel, scene list_objects/goal_near, and executor builtins (read/write/list_dir/run_command/get_all_plans/get_plan_status/stop_plan_at). The scene map persistence test (scene-map-persistence.txt) verified Save/Load/Delete with epoch sidecar: 16/16 checks passed.

suggested_fix: No fix needed. Monitor the scene-graph LLM enrichment warnings (JSONDecodeError from fake-vlm) — they are expected with the mock VLM and do not affect test outcomes. The scene map persistence test (16/16 checks) confirms the epoch-safe Save/Load/Delete works correctly.
risks_or_watchouts: Scene-graph LLM enrichment repeatedly fails with JSONDecodeError from fake-vlm — expected with mock, but a real VLM deployment must return valid JSON.

The lifecycle watcher's epoch response (flush + stale marking) is best-effort; a failure in _flush_registry or anno_store.mark_all_stale is logged but does not crash the watcher. Operators should monitor logs for these errors.

The legacy SCENE_RESTORE_ON_START mode is explicitly documented as incompatible with map-UI Saves — a Save purges the bare partition the legacy restore reads. Ensure operators understand this trade-off.
The scene map persistence test uses a fake object store (FakeObjectStore) — real milvus-lite behavior may differ under load or with concurrent access.
The nav2 velocity_guard shutdown traceback (RCLError: invalid context) is a known ROS2 shutdown race and does not affect test results.
